title: [Peek] Spinner busy cursor shown on every navigation event for media previewers
author: daverayment
summary: The media-spinner flicker report is already covered by the assigned maintainer’s open Peek previewer-reuse PR.

judgment.rationale: The issue is assigned and directly linked to an upstream PR that closes #50019 and specifically targets flicker caused by recreating previewers on navigation.
evidence: Issue #50019 includes a video of the spinner flashing while navigating MP3/video files in Peek.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
Open PR #49963 closes #50019 and describes previewer reuse as the fix for white-flash/flicker behavior during file navigation.
The PR adds reusable previewer infrastructure plus unit tests and media/image previewer changes.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR #49963 as the canonical fix attempt and do not create a second dashboard design for this same flicker regression.

fix_assessment.rationale: An active upstream PR from the assignee already covers the reported media-navigation flicker behavior.

issue_context.summary: Peek flashes the spinner on every media navigation even when loads are fast, but the maintainer who filed the issue already has an upstream PR addressing previewer reuse.
known_information: The report contains a concrete media-navigation repro and a video attachment.
The issue is assigned to daverayment.
The PR adds reusable previewer support, image buffering, and matching unit tests.
inferences: This issue is being fixed together with a broader Peek flicker reduction effort rather than as an isolated one-off.
Because the linked PR is still open, the correct dashboard state is handled-by-linked-fix rather than closed.
issue_context.analysis: Maintainers already have the right code path and owner. The artifact should preserve the link to PR #49963 and keep this issue out of the duplicate design queue.
initial_investigation: PR #49963 body says it reuses compatible previewers instead of always disposing and recreating them for every new item.
The same PR closes #50016, which indicates the maintainer is handling related Peek navigation/previewer regressions together.
